bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
docker image inspect gace-gaybbs-video-doorway-repair:20261123 >/dev/null || exit 70
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 test -f /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs || exit 71
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs || exit 72
docker exec -e VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_ENTRY_APPLY=disabled deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs >/tmp/video-two-topic-dryrun.out 2>/tmp/video-two-topic-dryrun.err || exit 73
echo VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_PREFLIGHT=PASS
